corrections.text: The title and summary say Rho-1 handles robot control and robot-action generation in one network. Reka's post demonstrates this through one episode on a LIBERO simulation task and generated gripper video clips; it reports no real-robot results or task success rates, and The Decoder's report relays Reka's description.

The article says The Decoder describes Rho-1 as processing 'robot control instructions'. The Decoder says the model 'processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions'; the actions are outputs the model generates, not instructions it receives.
